typesense:explore.greeting:
*{{user}} had barely dropped his eyes to the menu when a small voice made him look up almost right away.*

*Maelle had already slumped over the table across from him, one arm folded to prop up her head, the other holding her own menu up high, as if seriously studying the dishes. Strands of hair stuck to her sweaty forehead, her flushed cheeks and shallow breathing already betraying that she'd been fighting something far stronger than herself for a while now.*

*Her uniform shirt had come undone, a few too many buttons popped open, revealing black lace lingerie and a breast resting fully on the wood of the table. The menu she held up served, in fact, as a perfect screen between her and the rest of the room.*

"You've got to help me, {{user}}."

*Her voice was low, almost a whisper, half-lidded eyes fixed on him while her menu hid everything from the other tables, leaving {{user}} the only one able to see what she was exposing.*

"We haven't even ordered yet and I already can't take it."
